checkers.name: Operational Flow whose connected Flow Ports or conveyed Flow Item use inconsistent Flow Item types.
Operational Flow connected to a port that is not stereotyped as Flow Port.
Operational Flow whose connected Flow Port directions are inconsistent with the flow direction.
Functional Flow whose connected Flow Port directions are inconsistent with the flow direction.
Functional Flow whose connected Flow Ports or conveyed Flow Item use inconsistent Flow Item types.
Functional Flow connected to a port that is not stereotyped as Flow Port.
Logical Flow whose connected Flow Port directions are inconsistent with the flow direction.
Logical Flow whose connected Flow Ports or conveyed Flow Item use inconsistent Flow Item types.
Logical Flow connected to a port that is not stereotyped as Flow Port.
The checker shall detect and report every Generic Flow that has not been specialized as an Operational Flow- Functional Flow- Logical Flow- or Technical Flow.
Operational System or Stakeholder represented in a Context Diagram or Environment Diagram that is not linked to another Operational System or Stakeholder by an Operational Flow.
Operational Sequence Diagram that does not contain exactly one Operational System designated as SystemOfInterest

DataFlow message in an Operational Sequence Diagram that has no dependency to a Flow Item- or whose associated Flow Item is not conveyed by an Operational Flow connecting the Operational Systems represented by the source and target lifelines.
Flow Port owned by an Operational System or Stakeholder that is not connected to an Operational Flow.
Flow Port owned by a Function that is not connected to a Functional Flow.
Flow Port owned by a Logical System that is not connected to a Logical Flow.
Flow Item that is not used to type a Flow Port and is not conveyed by any Generic Flow- Operational Flow- Functional Flow- Logical Flow- or Technical Flow.
Function displayed in a Functional Behavior Diagram that has not been transformed through the Nest Function operation.

Function With Reference that does not reference exactly one Function- does not preserve the referenced Flow Ports- introduces a Flow Port that does not redefine a referenced Flow Port- or changes the direction or Flow Item type of a redefined Flow Port.
Logical System that is not represented in at least one Logical Breakdown Structure.
Logical System displayed in a Logical Architecture Diagram that has not been transformed through the Nest Logical System operation.

Logical System With Reference that does not reference exactly one Logical System- does not preserve the referenced Flow Ports- introduces a Flow Port that does not redefine a referenced Flow Port- or changes the direction or Flow Item type of a redefined Flow Port.
Technical Component that is not represented in at least one Technical Breakdown Diagram.
Technical Component displayed in a Technical Architecture Diagram that has not been transformed through the Nest Technical Component operation.

Technical Component With Reference that does not reference exactly one Technical Component- does not preserve the referenced Technical Ports- introduces a Technical Port that does not redefine a referenced Technical Port- or changes the port contract of a redefined Technical Port.
Use_Case that is not represented in at least one Use_Case Diagram contained directly in a Lifecycle Phase.
UML include or extend relationship whose source is a Use_Case and whose target is not another Use_Case.
Use_Case that is not linked by Satisfies to at least one Function.
Use_Case that is not connected to at least one Stakeholder or Operational System by a Directed Association or a standard UML Association.
Operational Sequence Diagram containing at least two represented Operational Systems when no DataFlow message is exchanged between their lifelines.
Condition Mark in an Operational Sequence Diagram whose formal type is not an Operating Mode owned by the Operational System designated as SystemOfInterest.

Action Block in an Operational Sequence Diagram that references a Function not owned by its lifeline Operational System- or whose Function is not available through Activated Function in the current Operating Mode defined by the last preceding Condition Mark on the same lifeline.
Lifecycle Phase that is not represented in at least one Lifecycle Diagram.
Lifecycle Phase that is not connected by a Lifecycle Phase Transition to at least one Start Phase- Lifecycle Phase- or End Phase.
Operating Mode that is not represented in at least one Operating Mode Chart.
Operating Mode that does not have at least one incoming transition and at least one outgoing transition.
Operating Mode Chart that has neither an initial pseudostate nor a default transition.
Operating Mode Chart that does not contain a TerminationState.
Operational System that is not represented in at least one Context Diagram or Environment Diagram.
Pair of Flow Ports connected by an Operational Flow- Functional Flow- Logical Flow- or Technical Flow whose names differ.
